recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. The current build-scope Resource $validate artifacts preserve the requested value set binding; future changes to $validate mode semantics should proceed under later tracker items rather than reopening FHIR-8002.
issue_request: FHIR-8002 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core BaseResource change request asking to add the Resource $validate mode parameter as a value set instead of leaving it as an unconstrained string.
initial_application: Jira records SVN revision 5534, and converted git commit 4f363ad0bd1afafaa97da59cb1cee0d469fcf2ef has the matching git-svn-id for build@5534. That commit changed the Resource operation spreadsheet so validate.mode became type code with the ResourceValidationMode binding and added the resource-validation-mode value set worksheet.
additional_context: The current source has since been refactored from spreadsheets into OperationDefinition, CodeSystem, and ValueSet XML. Later $validate work, including FHIR-41357, clarified mode semantics and resource/profile parameter rules but did not remove or weaken the required mode binding. FHIR-8446 separately corrected the mode=create definition typo in the same validation mode family.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/resource/operationdefinition-Resource-validate.xml already defines the mode input parameter as code with a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/resource-validation-mode, and source/resource/valueset-resource-validation-mode.xml composes the complete code system source/resource/codesystem-resource-validation-mode.xml.
